details:
Android 17, oscjson port binds to wwan (cellphone) data even if wifi is on and prefered

# Remote mdns browse response

avahi-browse -acrpt | grep VRChat-Client

=;bridge6;IPv4;VRChat-Client-A5C6A8;_osc._udp;local;Android_2ZPQG8IS.local;192.168.6.138;9000;

=;bridge6;IPv4;VRChat-Client-A5C6A8;_oscjson._tcp;local;Android_2ZPQG8IS.local;192.168.6.138;43535;

#ip addresses from phone

cheetah:/ $ ip addr show dev rmnet17                                                                                                                      

31: rmnet17: <POINTOPOINT,MULTICAST,NOARP,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1436 qdisc mq state UNKNOWN group default qlen 1000

    link/[519] 

    inet 48.X.X.93/32 scope global rmnet17

       valid_lft forever preferred_lft forever

cheetah:/ $ ip addr show dev wlan0                                                                                                                        

47: wlan0: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1500 qdisc pfifo_fast state UP group default qlen 1000

    link/ether 16:7e:5f:13:7b:15 brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff

    inet 192.168.6.138/24 brd 192.168.6.255 scope global dynamic wlan0

       valid_lft 64931sec preferred_lft 64931sec

       

#ports bound on phone connected to wifi and wwan

cheetah:/ $ ss -tnlup | grep 43535

Cannot open netlink socket: Permission denied

Cannot open netlink socket: Permission denied

tcp    LISTEN     0      0      48.X.X.93:43535              0.0.0.0:*  

cheetah:/ $ ss -tnlup | grep 9000                                                                                                                         

Cannot open netlink socket: Permission denied

Cannot open netlink socket: Permission denied

udp    UNCONN     0      0      0.0.0.0:9000               0.0.0.0:*   

if you disable mobile data it then binds to the waln0 (wifi) ip
title: oscjson binds to wrong ip on android
